queries.name: WfmActivityRelationshipReviewPreview
input: seed_task_ids: unique canonical UUIDv4 array with at least two WFM Tasks, canonical-sorted by task_id
steps: run against one stable read snapshot and create no command receipt, audit event, domain row or revision
load every seed Task and require task_kind=wfm plus a distinct canonical TK identity; missing Task/WFM identity returns TASK_NOT_FOUND
for retry_lineage require exactly two seed Tasks and one existing immutable direct retry edge between them; otherwise return TASK_ACTIVITY_LINEAGE_CONFLICT

expand the complete touched-lineage closure by indexed task_activity_lineage_current(activity_lineage_id,task_id) reads so every current member whose same-activity relationship would change is visible in the preview

load exact per-affected-Task Task revision, WFM assignment identity/revision, source projection revision/absence and source lifecycle/plan evidence, current operational plan revision/absence and interval, local execution/outcome projection revisions/states, retry adjacency and current lineage revision/id/last event/last decision
compute SOMA_WFM_ACTIVITY_RELATIONSHIP_REVIEW_V1 over the exact canonical authority described by commands/task-activity-review.json
derive whether accepting the requested decision is semantic NO_CHANGE under current authority
derive projected competing-attempt consequence without mutating authority; same_activity/retry_lineage/unresolved_source_error may preview competing_attempt=true and remain eligible for commit

return exact seed Task revisions, affected_task_count, bounded first affected-task page ordered by task_id, continuation cursor when needed, current/prospective lineage summary, retry relation id/null, projected competing-attempt flag and review_fingerprint
rules: preview is advisory read authority only; ReviewWfmActivityRelationship must recompute and exact-compare the fingerprint inside its writer UnitOfWork
transport paging of affected Tasks never changes the complete closure included in fingerprint/affected_task_count
source-plan fallback is conflict-evidence only and never becomes accepted operational Task-plan or Objective grouping authority
provider Complete/Plan Cancel alone never makes local work terminal
